summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming adds background SimCalorimeterHit contribution energies to merged hits and keeps entire hits whenever any contribution falls inside the time window, which changes calorimeter overlay output.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — Converts MCParticle production times from ns to mm/c before passing them to Delphes in k4SimDelphesAlg, which corrects particle, track and calorimeter times in Gaudi-based Delphes simulations.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — Fills the previously empty RecoMCLink collection in k4SimDelphesAlg by creating reco–MC links before internal maps are cleared
